## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

Closes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization
- [ ] `refactor`: Internal code refactoring
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `ci` / `build`: CI or build configuration changes
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project standards documented in [CONVENTIONS.md](./CONVENTIONS.md).
- [ ] I have formatted my code with `cargo fmt --all -- --check`.
- [ ] I have checked my code with `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`.
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass via `cargo test --all-targets`.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests covering the changes.
- [ ] I have updated documentation or examples if applicable.
